g.text: All member skills PASS under that Level's requirements
Each Level has its own skill requirements and competencies.
A Competency member must be required by its owning Level.
A Module teaches one or more Skills.
A Skill can have several teaching Modules.
Providers are alternatives, not all mandatory.
Select learning content through missing skills.
Check content depth against the selected Level.
Module completion does not automatically prove skill mastery.
Each TargetRole has one owning Occupation.
Repeated reported titles use distinct role IDs per Occupation.
Shared metadata: id, version, status, reviewStatus,
